items.title: Bridging technical depth and usability: The story behind Radar’s redesign

sentences.en: Bridging technical depth and usability: The story behind Radar’s redesign.
sentences.zh: 衔接技术深度和可用性：雷达重新设计背后的故事。

sentences.en: Radar provides a real-time view into global Internet trends, powered by Cloudflare’s global network.
sentences.zh: Radar提供全球互联网趋势的实时视图，由Cloudflare的全球网络提供支持。

sentences.en: We support Cloudflare’s mission to help build a better Internet by making web data visible, clear, and actionable for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我们支持Cloudflare的使命，即通过让每个人都能看到、清晰和可操作的网络数据，帮助构建更好的互联网。

sentences.en: Since launching in 2020 , Radar has found a natural audience amongst expert users with technical backgrounds, such as network operators and academic researchers who rely on Radar data to observe industry trends and global events.
sentences.zh: 自2020年推出以来，雷达在具有技术背景的专业用户中找到了天然的受众，例如网络运营商和学术研究人员，他们依靠雷达数据来观察行业趋势和全球事件。

sentences.en: But Radar also has the potential to be a more regular, self-serve resource for journalists, human rights advocates and policymakers, and everyday users.
sentences.zh: 但雷达也有可能成为记者、人权倡导者和政策制定者以及日常用户更常规的自助服务资源。

sentences.en: Making Radar accessible to a wider audience is a core part of our vision, so we knew it was time to reevaluate the user experience: How could we make Radar more approachable to broader audiences, while preserving the depth and rigor that we currently have?
sentences.zh: 向更广泛的受众提供雷达是我们愿景的核心部分，因此我们知道现在是重新评估用户体验的时候了：我们如何让雷达更接近更广泛的受众，同时保持我们目前的深度和严谨性？

sentences.en: In this blog post, we’ll introduce the redesigned Radar, share our design process, and outline our broader vision for the platform’s future.
sentences.zh: 在这篇博客文章中，我们将介绍重新设计的雷达，分享我们的设计流程，并概述我们对平台未来的更广泛愿景。

sentences.en: Challenges with the previous design While the previous landing page was successful at showing the breadth of Radar’s data, the way that information was presented made it difficult to parse.
sentences.zh: 以前设计的挑战虽然以前的着陆页成功地显示了雷达数据的广度，但信息的呈现方式使其难以解析。

sentences.en: The bento box layout gave everything similar visual weight, the vertical cards disrupted natural reading patterns, and the styling felt disconnected from Cloudflare’s broader brand.
sentences.zh: 便当盒布局赋予了一切相似的视觉重量，垂直卡片打破了自然的阅读模式，造型感觉与Cloudflare更广泛的品牌脱节。

sentences.en: We heard this from users.
sentences.zh: 我们从用户那里听到了这一点。

sentences.en: One external user mentioned that one of his biggest frustrations with Radar was that it was difficult to show to his students.
sentences.zh: 一位外部用户提到，他对雷达的最大挫折之一是难以向学生展示。

sentences.en: That feedback reinforced the problem that Radar could feel intimidating to people encountering it for the first time.
sentences.zh: 这种反馈强化了雷达可能对第一次遇到它的人感到恐惧的问题。

sentences.en: NGOs in Indonesian Borneo file class action lawsuit calling for government to better manage annual fires and The Indonesian government has been accused of “gross negligence” in a class action lawsuit over its handling of wildfires that have cloaked large parts of South-east Asia in a toxic haze, shuttered schools and caused a spike in respiratory illnesses.

items.title: Secret protection must scale with software

sentences.en: Secret protection must scale with software.
sentences.zh: 秘密保护必须随软件一起扩展。

sentences.en: Today, one in three pull requests on GitHub involves an AI agent .
sentences.zh: 如今， GitHub上每三个拉取请求中就有一个涉及AI代理。

sentences.en: A year ago, that number was fewer than one in 10.
sentences.zh: 一年前，这个数字还不到十分之一。

sentences.en: If that pace holds, within the next two years, most of the code pushed to GitHub could be written by an agent.
sentences.zh: 如果这种速度持续下去，在未来两年内，推送到GitHub的大部分代码都可能由代理编写。

sentences.en: Much of it may never be fully read by a human.
sentences.zh: 其中大部分可能永远不会被人类完全阅读。

sentences.en: If developers and agents move faster, we have a responsibility to ensure protection keeps up with the accelerated rate of code creation.
sentences.zh: 如果开发人员和代理商行动更快，我们有责任确保保护跟上代码创建的加速速度。

sentences.en: That means preventing more leaks before they happen and making the response to exposures that remain less dependent on manual human effort.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在泄漏发生之前预防更多的泄漏，并对不太依赖人工操作的暴露做出反应。

sentences.en: This is a pivotal point for leaked secrets.
sentences.zh: 这是泄露秘密的关键点。

sentences.en: Developers aren t becoming more careless; they re being outpaced.
sentences.zh: 开发人员并没有变得更加粗心大意；他们正在被超越。

sentences.en: The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it.
sentences.zh: 让开发人员创建更多软件的工具也应该承担更多的保护工作。

sentences.en: In this essay, I share the nine quarters of data behind that claim.
sentences.zh: 在这篇文章中，我分享了这一说法背后的九个季度的数据。

sentences.en: I also introduce the fine-tuned classifier we built with Microsoft Applied Sciences to extend push protection to unstructured secrets.
sentences.zh: 我还介绍了我们使用Microsoft Applied Sciences构建的微调分类器，以将推送保护扩展到非结构化机密。

items.title: Building an evidence-grounded agentic security operations harness on Cloudflare

sentences.en: Building an evidence-grounded agentic security operations harness on Cloudflare.
sentences.zh: 在Cloudflare上构建基于证据的代理安全运营工具。

sentences.en: Security alerts rarely arrive one at a time.
sentences.zh: 安全警报很少会一次一个到达。

sentences.en: A single alert can cause a spike across the environment, requiring a human analyst to decide which alerts are related and what they mean.
sentences.zh: 单个警报可能会导致整个环境出现峰值，需要人工分析师确定哪些警报是相关的，以及它们的含义。

sentences.en: When multiple arrive at the same time, it can quickly overwhelm even a seasoned security analyst.
sentences.zh: 当多个同时到达时，即使是经验丰富的安全分析师也会很快不知所措。

sentences.en: Enter the alert paradox.
sentences.zh: 输入警报悖论。

sentences.en: Now, our built-in, multi-AI-agent security operations harness can handle more of this work at Cloudflare scale.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们内置的多AI代理安全运营工具可以在Cloudflare规模上处理更多此类工作。

sentences.en: Our Cloudflare Managed Defense AI agent harness speeds up the process of gathering data, connecting and aggregating detections, and accounting for missing sources while new alerts continue to arrive.
sentences.zh: 我们的Cloudflare托管防御AI代理加快了收集数据、连接和聚合检测以及在新警报继续到达的同时解决缺失来源的过程。

sentences.en: To further analyze context, we make use of the OpenAI Daybreak Defense Network and our partnership with Anthropic.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步分析背景，我们利用OpenAI黎明防御网络以及我们与Anthropic的合作伙伴关系。

sentences.en: Cloudflare uses approved OpenAI Daybreak and Anthropic models, including GPT-5.6 Cyber and Mythos, for deeper model-backed analysis.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare使用经批准的OpenAI Daybreak和Anthropic模型，包括GPT-5.6 Cyber和Mythos ，进行更深入的模型支持分析。

sentences.en: Initial analysis and scoring is done with Clef , Cloudflare’s open-source decision model.
sentences.zh: 使用Cloudflare的开源决策模型Clef进行初步分析和评分。

sentences.en: Collecting evidence to understand what each alert means requires a lot of time.
Even in a highly sophisticated Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), too much is still left for a human to review.
